title: kompli Result
description: Canonical result JSON emitted by `kompli audit` / `remediate`. Per-rule `tags` and inline `metadata` are echoed from the unified benchmark-definition input; additional properties are permitted for forward compatibility.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the run started.

host.description: Provenance of the scanned host. Benchmark definitions are architecture-agnostic, so the arch/distribution a result was produced on is recorded here for multi-arch traceability.

arch.description: System architecture derived from DistributionInfo, e.g. "x86_64".

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the run in milliseconds.

status.description: Overall status, aggregated across rules with the engine's allOf three-valued logic: NonCompliant if any rule is NonCompliant; otherwise NotApplicable if any rule is NotApplicable, or if a section (rule ID prefix) filter matched no rules; otherwise Compliant.

rules.description: One entry per evaluated rule, in evaluation order.

indicators.description: The engine's step-by-step reasoning tree for the rule.

title.description: Human-readable rule title (the ResourceID; reuses the definition's field name).

id.description: The rule's externally-quoted, framework-defined identifier, opaque and unique within its benchmark definition.

ruleId.description: Stable, benchmark-agnostic rule identifier preserved from the benchmark definition for external correlation.

status.description: Per-rule status. Skipped is accepted for forward compatibility with unevaluated rules. Overall status is aggregated with the engine's allOf three-valued logic (CombineAllOf): NonCompliant dominates; otherwise NotApplicable propagates; otherwise Compliant.

tags.description: Flat, sparse 'axis:value' tags echoed verbatim from the definition. Runtime limits each decoded UTF-8 tag to 256 bytes; maxLength also bounds code points.

metadata.description: Descriptive fields echoed verbatim from the definition.

parameters.description: Effective parameters (payload defaults merged with any user overrides).
